preview.tournamentOverview: The RSM Classic is played on the Seaside Course at Sea Island Golf Club, a short, accurate, and scoring-friendly layout. The course rewards approach play and around-the-green skill over raw distance, with approach 7%) and around-the-green 6%) strokes gained carrying the heaviest weights. This event matters as a final tune-up before the off-season and a last chance for players to secure 2025 PGA Tour status.
preview.modelExplainer: Our model weights approach play most heavily at 7%, followed by around-the-green at 6% and total strokes gained at 7%. Driving accuracy 5%) and putting 4%) receive lower emphasis, reflecting the course's emphasis on precision iron play and short-game recovery over power or putting volume. Bogey avoidance and birdie/bogey ratio each carry 0% weight, underscoring the importance of consistent scoring rather than aggressive play.
preview.pickApproach: We tier bets by combining current form with course fit, prioritizing players strong in approach and around-the-green metrics. Top-tier targets show positive strokes gained in the heavily weighted categories and favorable power rankings. Mid-tier bets target players with strong total strokes gained but slightly weaker course-specific skills, while long-shot bets focus on players with outlier approach or around-the-green numbers despite lower overall rankings.

article.title: RSM Classic 2026: Model Ranks Hisatsune, Yellamaraju, Lipsky Highest at Sea Island
article.dek: Tournament model places Ryo Hisatsune (rank 1), Sudarshan Yellamaraju (rank 2), and David Lipsky (rank 3) at the top of the 141-player field for the Seaside Course.
article.introduction: The RSM Classic model weights approach-the-green 7%) and off-the-tee 1%) most heavily for Sea Island. Hisatsune leads the model with 238 SG total and a 20-power-rank gap, while Yellamaraju and Lipsky follow at 34 and 89 SG total respectively. All three skipped the Scottish Open and carry zero tracked rounds in the major-swing workload window.

sections.heading: Tournament Overview
sections.body: The RSM Classic at Sea Island Seaside Course carries a 141-player field and places the heaviest course weights on approach-the-green 7%) and around-the-green 6%). The model ranks Hisatsune first, Yellamaraju second, and Lipsky third among all entrants.

sections.heading: Course Fit
sections.body: Hisatsune posts 576 SG approach and 181 SG around-the-green, aligning with the two highest-weighted categories. Yellamaraju shows 474 SG approach and 616 SG putting, while Lipsky leads the trio with 524 SG around-the-green.

sections.heading: Recent Form
sections.body: No recent-round data are supplied for any of the three players. The model therefore relies on season-long strokes-gained totals rather than last-start results.

sections.heading: Post-Open Workload
sections.body: All three players record zero tracked rounds in the major-swing workload window. The classifications note that zero tracked rounds does not equate to rest.

sections.heading: FedExCup Motivation
sections.body: Hisatsune sits at FedExCup #47 (SAFE_TOP_50), Yellamaraju at #58 (BUBBLE_51_80), and Lipsky at #85 (CHASING_81_PLUS).

sections.heading: Crossover Research Angles
sections.body: Each player skipped the Scottish Open and holds a top-10 model rank that exceeds his power rank by at least five spots. Hisatsune leads the model at rank 1 versus power rank 20; Yellamaraju is model rank 2 versus power rank 19; Lipsky is model rank 3 versus power rank 24.

sections.heading: Outright Targets
sections.body: The model identifies Hisatsune (rank 1) and Yellamaraju (rank 2) as the two strongest outright candidates. Both carry the largest positive gaps between model rank and power rank among the supplied players.

sections.heading: Top-10 Targets
sections.body: Hisatsune, Yellamaraju, and Lipsky occupy the top three model ranks and are the only players listed for top-10 consideration. Their SG totals 238, 34, 89) exceed all other supplied names.

sections.heading: Top-20 Targets
sections.body: The same three players remain the model-supported top-20 selections. No additional players from the supplied list meet the model threshold for this tier.

sections.heading: Data Limitations
sections.body: Weather and tee-time data are not available in this pipeline; the article does not make weather- or tee-time-specific claims.

sections.heading: Final Betting Card
sections.body: Tier 1 (model-supported): Hisatsune and Yellamaraju for outright, top-5, top-10, and top-20. Tier 2 (model-supported): Lipsky for top-10 and top-20 only.

article.conclusion: Model-supported card: Hisatsune and Yellamaraju across all four bet types; Lipsky for top-10 and top-20 only. All recommendations rest on model rank, SG totals, and crossover research differentials supplied above.
